newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM says not in firm alliance talks.
newsitem.headline: KLM says not in firm alliance talks.

text.p: Dutch carrier KLM said on Thursday it was still seeking a European partner but it was not in firm alliance talks.
"There are no concrete (partnership) talks with airlines," outgoing president and chief executive officer Pieter Bouw said at a lunch with foreign journalists.
KLM has repeatedly stated it is seeking a European partner to help boost its European market share to 15 percent from a current eight percent.

But Bouw dismissed suggestions KLM might have missed its chance to forge an alliance and bolster its market position, saying the 15 percent target should be seen within the context of far-reaching European airline consolidation.
"The European aviation market is still very fragmented... alliance formation in Europe is still at the beginning.. and therefore KLM still has its options," he said.
These options included Iberia, Swissair and Alitalia and, to a lesser extent, Air France, he said.
However, KLM was not in firm alliance talks with airlines, he added.
